description: This file is a shell script used to set up a PostgreSQL database environment for the customer-management-billing system. It checks for the presence of psql client, creates a database and user if they do not exist, grants privileges, and imports a schema from an external SQL file. It also provides instructions for connecting to the database.
calls: psql -U postgres -h localhost -p $DB_PORT -c "CREATE USER $DB_USER WITH PASSWORD '$DB_PASSWORD';"
psql -U postgres -h localhost -p $DB_PORT -c "GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE $DB_NAME TO $DB_USER;"
